tensura_minecolonies.configuration.title: Tensura MineColonies Integration
tensura_minecolonies.colony.created.gobl: News of your new goblin town spreads far and wide. Wild goblins drawn to your banner will appear in your territory — name them, and they will serve.
tensura_minecolonies.colony.created.orc: Whispers of your orc settlement carry on the wind. Wild orcs answering the call will arrive in your territory — name them, and they will serve.
tensura_minecolonies.masterwork_schemati: Masterwork forging techniques learned! Combine a hihiirokane weapon with a Masterwork Weapon Core at a Smithing Bench.
You already know the Masterwork forging techniques.
Fills as you redeem villagers (Show of Faith).
Fills as you sacrifice subordinates (The Blood Sacrifice).
Bound to you — only you can fill or offer it.
item.tensura_minecolonies.twin_grail.day: The Grail brims with holy light — you are healed and cleansed.
item.tensura_minecolonies.twin_grail.nig: The Grail runs red — the vampire's vigor is yours.
item.tensura_minecolonies.twin_grail.des: By day: heal and cleanse all ailments.
By night: might, swiftness, and life-drain.
tensura_minecolonies.trial.begin.human: The Trial of Light & Dark begins. Fill the chalice of holy water by redeeming villagers, and the chalice of blood by sacrificing your subordinates.
tensura_minecolonies.trial.begin.majin: The Trial of Light & Dark begins. Luminous demands more of a majin: redeem villagers and raise a new generation, and give up your three strongest subordinates.
tensura_minecolonies.trial.dark.not_stro: Luminous is unmoved — a majin must offer their STRONGEST. This one's blood does not fill the chalice.
tensura_minecolonies.trial.holy.full: The chalice of holy water is full.
tensura_minecolonies.trial.blood.full: The chalice of blood is full.
item.tensura_minecolonies.seal_of_ascens: Use on one of your subordinates: EP ×1.25, then ×1.5 EP growth for 30 minutes.
The seal is still recharging (%s min).
The seal only answers for your own subordinates.
%s ascends — EP %s → %s. Its growth is quickened for %s minutes.
item.tensura_minecolonies.otherworld_cod: Performs a summoning rite: an otherworlder appears at your side as your subordinate.
The codex is still recharging (%s min).
item.tensura_minecolonies.holy_field_sto: Raises a holy field for 30 seconds. Enemies inside can't use skills or magic and take holy damage. Your side is unaffected.
The stone is still recharging (%s min).
item.tensura_minecolonies.pack_mark.desc: Mark a mob as prey for 60 seconds. Your nearby subordinates hunt it, deal 50% more damage to it, and heal when it dies.
item.tensura_minecolonies.pack_mark.rech: The mark is still recharging (%s min).
item.tensura_minecolonies.pack_mark.no_t: Look at a mob to mark it.
item.tensura_minecolonies.pack_mark.not_: You can't mark your own side.
item.tensura_minecolonies.pack_mark.mark: %s is marked as prey. %s of your subordinates join the hunt for %s seconds.
item.tensura_minecolonies.holy_field_sto: A Holy Field rises. Enemies within are sealed for %s seconds.
tensura_minecolonies.otherworlder.joined: %s now serves you. Find them in your roster (G), where you can send them to your colony.
